spec.description:
Thermotec MaxTape FR
(Maxflex Insulating Foam Tape) is a high-performance, fire-rated EPDM
closed-cell elastomeric insulating foam tape coated on one side with an
aggressive acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesive. Engineered for thermal
insulation, vibration dampening, and condensation control, it is widely used as
a purlin tape on steel-framed buildings to reduce thermal movement creaks, and
as an insulation wrap for pipe fittings, valves, and HVAC components. Flexible
and lightweight, it retards heat gain and loss while providing long service life
without deterioration.
features:
Made from closed-cell fire-rated EPDM
elastomeric insulating foam sheet

Coated with high-tack acrylic
pressure-sensitive adhesive protected by release liner

Serves as an effective
purlin tape to eliminate thermal movement noise in steel buildings

Low,
stable thermal conductivity retards heat loss, heat gain, and prevents
condensation

Fire-rated formulation compliant with building safety
standards

Highly flexible and conforms easily to irregular pipe fittings,
valves, and bends

Resistant to moisture absorption, weathering, and UV
degradation
Will not dry out, shrink, or deteriorate over time

Available
in 50mm and 98mm widths in 3mm thickness

technical.value: Closed-cell EPDM elastomeric insulating foam with acrylic adhesive

Stable low thermal
conductivity for thermal insulation and anti-condensation

Closed-cell
structure resists moisture and condensation

spec.fire:
Fire-rated formulation;
low flammability EPDM rubber
spec.compliance:
Meets Australian building and HVAC
insulation performance standards
spec.sustainability:
Zero ODP; low VOC
emissions; fiber-free
install:
Ensure target pipe, fitting, or purlin
surface is clean, dry, and free of grease and dust

For purlin installation,
unroll MaxTape FR along the top flange of steel roof purlins or wall girts
Peel back release liner and press tape firmly onto the steel surface

Ensure
tape runs continuously beneath roof or wall sheets to eliminate thermal
expansion noise

For pipe fittings and valves, wrap MaxTape FR tightly with
a 50% overlap to achieve required insulation thickness

Press firmly along all
edges to ensure complete, gap-free adhesion and prevent air ingress
selection_checklist:
Confirm application (purlin thermal cushion tape vs
pipe fitting lagging)

Select width (50mm standard for pipe fittings and
narrow purlins; 98mm for wide structural purlins)

Calculate total lineal
meters needed along steel framing or pipe runs

Ensure substrate is clean and
grease-free
limitations:
Surfaces must be dry and
free of oil or rust before applying

Not designed as a structural load-bearing
tape
Ensure 50% overlap when wrapping pipes to prevent condensation tracking
spec.warranty: Backed by Thermotec Australia product warranty

problem_keywords: metal roof creaking and popping from heat expansion
condensation on copper pipe fittings and valves
use_cases:
Applied along the top of steel purlins in sheds and metal-roof
buildings to eliminate thermal expansion creaks and groans

Insulating
irregular pipe valves, tees, elbows, and short pipe runs where pre-formed
tubular lagging cannot fit

Anti-sweat and condensation protection wrapping on
refrigeration and chilled water pipe fittings
retrieval.rag_summary:
Thermotec MaxTape FR (Maxflex
Insulating Foam Tape) is a fire-rated EPDM closed-cell elastomeric foam tape
(3mm thick in 50mm and 98mm widths) backed with high-tack acrylic
pressure-sensitive adhesive. Serving a dual purpose, it insulates irregular pipe
fittings, valves, and HVAC components against condensation and heat loss while
functioning as a high-performance purlin tape on steel-framed buildings to
eliminate thermal expansion creaking. Closed-cell, moisture-impermeable, and
UV-resistant, it provides long-term thermal and acoustic cushioning without
deteriorating.
